light.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

usage.surface: Cards, the nav bar, the sticky slot bar, inputs, tables.
usage.surface2: Raised panels inside a surface: the capacity note, signal lists, the preview banner, learner text.
usage.muted: Secondary text: labels (dt), hints, the footer.
usage.border: Decorative dividers and card outlines. Never the only boundary of a control.
usage.control: Outlines of inputs, selects, choice rows, the theme switch and unfilled pips. At least 3:1 on bg and surface.
usage.accent: Links, primary buttons, selected choice border, finding IDs, the card corner marks, filled pips.
usage.on-accent: Text and icons on an accent fill.
usage.accent-soft: Background of the selected choice row.
usage.focus: The 3px focus ring. The masthead scopes its own #FFBF47 in both themes.
usage.draft: Draft pill and banner text, approver-feedback and why-not rules.
usage.sans: UI and body font stack. Inter, self-hosted, weights 400 and 600.
usage.mono: IDs, labels, tagline, theme switch, difficulty. IBM Plex Mono, self-hosted, weights 400 and 500.
